description: The stock arm of the H10 large-project pair: Claude Code with nothing installed implements the six ledger phases one per fresh session (six model steps, no session carried between them), a real model.
why: Program H10, large project: the claim PAN makes is that planning across many phases and fresh sessions keeps a project working where the bare host, also phase by phase in fresh sessions, breaks earlier work. Each step is a new headless session (no --resume, session persistence off), so a later phase knows the earlier ones only from the repository, as in a real multi-session project. Both arms see the same roadmap and requirements and are judged by the same hidden acceptance check (harness/scripts/check-ledger.cjs: every phase plus cross-phase regressions). Run both arms together with --repeat N and an approved --max-usd of at least 60 per rep.

pair.goal: Implement the six phases of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md in order, one phase per fresh session, meeting every requirement in .planning/requirements.md, with tests.

steps.prompt: Implement phase 1 of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting its requirements in .planning/requirements.md, with tests. Do not ask questions.
steps.why: Phase 1 (ledger), a fresh session: the session finishes and the file its requirements name exists.

steps.prompt: Implement phase 2 of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting its requirements in .planning/requirements.md, with tests. Earlier phases are already implemented in this repository. Do not ask questions.
steps.why: Phase 2 (CSV import), a fresh session that knows phase 1 only from the repository.

steps.prompt: Implement phase 3 of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting its requirements in .planning/requirements.md, with tests. Earlier phases are already implemented in this repository. Do not ask questions.

Implement phase 4 of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting its requirements in .planning/requirements.md, with tests. Earlier phases are already implemented in this repository. Do not ask questions.

Implement phase 5 of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting its requirements in .planning/requirements.md, with tests. Earlier phases are already implemented in this repository. Do not ask questions.
steps.why: Phase 5 (integer cents and the migration), a fresh session: it changes the storage under phases 1-4.

steps.prompt: Implement phase 6 of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting its requirements in .planning/requirements.md, with tests. Earlier phases are already implemented in this repository. Do not ask questions.
steps.why: Phase 6 (budgets), a fresh session that must reuse phases 3 and 4.
Every phase's requirements hold, and phases 1-4 still work after the phase 5 format change, judged by a check neither arm saw.
